note.title: Healthy living and lifestyle
note.specFocus: diet, exercise, wellbeing, habits and giving advice
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
1.2 Healthy living and lifestyle
Key focus
- diet, exercise, wellbeing, habits and giving advice.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use time frequency phrases, modal expressions for advice, and connect opinions with clear reasons.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I swim twice a week because it relaxes me.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Faccio nuoto due volte alla settimana perché mi rilassa.”

How often does the speaker swim, and why?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I usually eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast and drink water.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Di solito a colazione mangio yogurt con frutta e bevo acqua.”

What does the speaker usually have for breakfast?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: When I was little, I ate too many sweets and did no sport.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Quando ero piccolo mangiavo troppi dolci e non facevo sport.”

How was the speaker’s lifestyle different in childhood?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: After school I walk home instead of taking the bus.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Dopo scuola cammino fino a casa invece di prendere l’autobus.”

What choice does the speaker make after school?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Yesterday I felt very tired because I had slept only a few hours.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Ieri mi sentivo molto stanco perché avevo dormito poche ore.”

Why did the speaker feel tired yesterday?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: In the future I would like to stop eating crisps and sleep more.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“In futuro vorrei smettere di mangiare patatine e dormire di più.”

Name two future lifestyle changes the speaker wants to make.
